summary: Practise credible leadership communication, feedback and follow-through. Explore the five-day building trust training course and review the outline.
lede: Building trust as a leader means making commitments clear, explaining decisions and responding constructively when expectations are missed. For supervisors, project leads and developing managers, this course uses the Mayer trust model and Trust Equation to assess credibility and strengthen follow-through. You will practise SBI feedback conversations, distinguish evidence from assumptions and prepare a trust-repair conversation with clear next steps.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is for people who lead work, make decisions or represent a team and need their actions to earn confidence in routine and difficult situations.
prerequisites: No prior trust framework is required. Familiarity with workplace communication and responsibility for coordinating or leading work will help you apply the exercises. Coding is not required.
